text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(And so henceforth, preparations for
Windy's Demonic Castle were
coming
along swimmingly.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(With the increase in our ranks came a
certain tendency for some
things to go
awry, however...)

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
What, you wanna black out every window?
I'm not sure that's a good
idea. If we make
everything dark, you won't even be able to
see
where the walls are.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A demonic castle's gotta be totally
pitch-black! What if we just
bought even
more black fabric?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
That would probably put us over budget...
We've got so many other
aspects to focus
on as well.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: B-but! The room's just gotta be pitch-black! Everything need to be covered!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Erm... I mean, I'll give it another look, but please don't get your hopes up. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yo, my liege! That's why I love ya!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You want to build the best castle and do
your legion proud, yeah?
Mad respect for
sticking to the vision!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, y-yeah! This has to be the coolest
castle ever, so yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And you, nice Demon Queen minioning!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Huh, m-me? "Nice minioning"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're trying your best to uphold your
queen's wishes, right? Thanks
so much for
handling all the budget stuff.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm just doing the job I was given,
and I want this to succeed
too, so...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's it, that's it! We're all seeking those
success with a smile
vibes! ☆ So maybe
you can cook a little more with the whole

pitch-black thing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we can find something that works!
So we wanna make sure the
room is
pitch-black, walls included, huh?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Pitch-black... Pitch-black... Oh, I've got it!
We've got some
construction paper left
over from making the hallway decorations!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I think I remember there being tons of
black left over! We could
cover the walls
with that!

text_block_list.name: Windy & Classmate A
text_block_list.text: It's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: We're so back! ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Digital? Digital, get it together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, th-thank you, Doto. I might have been
buzzing too close to that
blinding light...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
At this very moment, I fully understand the
mind of a moth. How could
I not be drawn
in when those two handled that
disagreement with the
kind of grace I
could only dream of?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad that Palmer and Helios were
able to help us out. Truly,
from the bottom
of my heart...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hm? B-but you've done so much for us
too, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Oh, there you go again! You're much
too kind, Doto. Digitan's
presence is but a
drop in the bucket.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even speak up in the presence
of conflict. An otaku dares
not to pressure
her oshi.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-but...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Can you give some advice for this
outfit?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! Be right there!
...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Phew! It's coming along! We're cutting it
close, but I can see the light
at the end of
the tunnel!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I can hardly wait for the day of! It's
shaping up to be a Solefall
Faire exhibit
for the ages!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So true! I wonder if Rubae and Miracle will
show up too? Even got a
LANE message
from Jordan yesterday telling me that it's
lookin' lit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Better tell her you're looking forward to
her pulling up, then! ♪ And
you know, I
can't help but think as all this is going
down...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Windy's something else.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get that! Love the vibes her type
gives off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what can I say? It's just nice to see
her do her thing. Even if she
comes off a
little selfish, she's got a strong vision, and
she knows it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This might come off as a bit stiff, but I
really respect that. You have
to be pretty
strong to pull off that kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So yeah... Um... Y'know...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Palmster?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh... So hey, Helios.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've got my own selfish request to make, so
uhhh... you mind?
